title: A manager publishes a week and a second human acknowledges it, in one live world

backendBuild.detail: branch HEAD, stamped by test/e2e/scripts/live-world.sh at 2026-08-06T14:19:12.523Z, pid 96293 (which was serving this origin) still running

steps.name: sign in as the manager through the platform-admin door
both flags this week-run depends on are deny-closed
PROBE: with workforce.publication down, the week cannot even be drafted
steps.detail: Vaktplanen er skrivebeskyttet Bryteren workforce.publication står av for denne butikken, så vaktplanen kan leses, men ikke endres eller publ

steps.name: the manager turns schedule publication on
the seeded colleague is on the roster with no login
steps.detail: Astrid Vik: Ingen innlogging er koblet til engasjementet ennå. Personen kan settes opp på vakter, men kan ikke logge inn og se dem.

steps.name: issue the claim code, which is shown exactly once
steps.detail: a 43-character claim code was issued and withheld from this record

steps.name: build the week: draft, one shift for the colleague, validated
steps.detail: 08:00–16:00 Barista for Astrid Vik, week validated

steps.name: a DIFFERENT person signs in and claims the code
steps.detail: claimed by applicationUserId eac8b9d0-1bdc-42f7-b294-ded88152a380, which is NOT the publisher 6ba6dd27-42b0-4ba9-807b-96930c735f2f

steps.name: the worker sees the shift the manager published
steps.detail: first shift card: 08:00–16:00 Barista Betalt tid 7t 30m Åpningsvakt Fra publisering 1

steps.name: PROBE: with workforce.selfservice down, the confirmation is refused
steps.detail: refused: "Kunne ikke bekrefte mottak." — the notice is still unread

steps.name: the worker confirms, and is shown NOTHING (F-WF-ACKNOWLEDGE-SHOWS-NOTHING)
